<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that, for the product COc1cccc(C(=O)NC(=O)c1nnn(Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)c1N)c1, breaks an aryl halide and forms a ketone (the typical Friedel‑Crafts acylation transformation).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(C(=O)NC(=O)c1nnn(Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)c1N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aryl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
